    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])

    parts=[]

        if len(set(grid[i][j] for i in range(h)))==1 and flat[grid[0][j]]==h:
            parts.append(([r[:j] for r in grid],[r[j+1:] for r in grid]))
    for i in range(h):

            parts.append(([r[:] for r in grid[:i]],[r[:] for r in grid[i+1:]]))

        inter=set(Counter(v for r in a for v in r)) & set(Counter(v for r in b for v in r))
        if len(inter)==1:
